description: A SQL script for setting up the 'work_item' table in a PostgreSQL database, including table creation, indexes, policies, and trigger functions for managing work items (tasks and bugs) with project-key-based incremental IDs in a Supabase backend.
calls: select coalesce(max(w.id), 0) + 1 from public.work_item w where w.project_id = NEW.project_id
